meta_description: Johnson's Rendering and Plastering Service in Birmingham. Expert rendering, plastering, and decorative finishes. Free quotes and fast turnaround.
hero_eyebrow: Expert Rendering & Plastering — Birmingham's Trusted Finish
hero_subhead: From cracked render to fresh interior plaster, we restore and protect your home's appearance with precision and care.
services_subhead: We handle external render restoration, interior plastering, decorative finishes, and damp-prevention work for homes and businesses throughout the Midlands.

services.title: External Render Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Cracked or failing render leaves your home vulnerable to damp and water ingress. We strip, prepare, and apply fresh render—choosing the right finish for your property's age and exposure.

services.title: Interior Plastering
services.desc: Smooth, flat walls and ceilings that take decoration beautifully. We plaster new-build, refurbishment, and repair work to exacting standards.

services.title: Decorative Finishes
services.desc: Feature walls, textured finishes, and specialist coatings that add character and depth. We apply Venetian plaster, lime finish, and bespoke effects to order.

services.title: Damp-Proof Rendering
services.desc: Facing rising or penetrating damp? Our damp-inhibiting render systems and tanking solutions prevent water ingress and protect your home's structure long-term.

services.title: Lime Render & Traditional Finishes
services.desc: For period properties and heritage work, we specialise in lime-based render that breathes naturally and respects your home's original construction.

services.title: Prep & Finishing Work
services.desc: From scaffold setup to final paint-ready surface, we manage the whole job—ensuring timely completion and a clean site when we leave.

about_pullquote: I got into this trade because I hated seeing shoddy render work ruin a good home.
about_para_1: Johnson's Rendering and Plastering was founded 18 years ago in Handsworth with a simple commitment: deliver finishes that last and look right. Over nearly two decades, we've restored and protected thousands of Birmingham properties—from Victorian terraces to modern new-builds—learning the quirks of the region's climate and building stock along the way.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, finishing on schedule, and leaving your property cleaner than we found it. We invest in quality materials and don't cut corners on prep work, because a poor base means a poor finish. Most of our work now comes from repeat customers and referrals—a testament to the trust we've earned across Birmingham and the Black Country.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our 1930s semi. The render was patchwork and letting damp in, but Mark and the lads sorted it completely. New render looks immaculate, matched the old perfectly. Paid what we agreed, finished early, and left zero mess. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had the whole kitchen replastered after we ripped out some old units. Walls came up dead straight and smooth as silk. The decorator said it was the best prep he'd seen in years. Fair price, no hassle, and they cleaned up properly every day. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Called them in a panic about rising damp showing through the render. Johnson's came out same week, explained the problem clearly, and quoted a sensible solution. The damp-proofing render they applied has held up brilliantly over winter. Professional crew, honest pricing.
reviews.author: Paul H.
